Name: AccuWeather for Windows 8 x64
Description: AccuWeather has the Superior Accuracy™, custom views, and weather animations you love! It is fun-to-use, reliable, and will make all the difference in your day. This award winning app is available in 27 languages. We designed it with you in mind because so many decisions are made based on the weather. You get a quick look at current weather conditions for the next 72 hours with an easy swipe to a calendar view of the forecasted conditions for each of the next 25 days – including the option to open up any of the 25 days for more weather detail! You also get: • Severe weather notices to keep you ahead of the storm. • A Local Forecast Summary that gives you a quick brief of the most significant weather event forecasted for your location over the next several days. A Windows® app designed using Microsoft’s Windows® 8.1 Interface with fluid screen resizing to the snap view, and large, medium, small and wide Live Tile support for all your favorite locations. The Tiles automatically peek and refresh with current forecasts and weather maps. • Current weather conditions update every 15 minutes with the very latest humidity percentages, visibility, UV index, wind speed, direction and wind gusts, and RealFeel® – AccuWeather’s exclusive weather forecasting system that analyzes multiple weather conditions to determine how the local temperature actually feels. • Fully interactive, full-screen Bing Maps overlaid with AccuWeather’s precise weather data, including U.S., Canadian, European, and Japanese radar. Download AccuWeather for free and take advantage of the Superior Accuracy™ and local weather information for your PC and tablet!

Name: Where's My Water
Description: Get the GAME OF THE YEAR award-winning puzzler! Help Swampy by guiding water to his broken shower. Each level is a challenging physics-based puzzle with amazing life-like mechanics. Cut through dirt to guide fresh water, dirty water, toxic water, steam, and ooze through increasingly challenging scenarios! Every drop counts! • Original Stories & Characters – Play through 4 unique stories featuring Swampy, Allie, Cranky and Mystery Duck. That’s over 500 amazing puzzles! • Innovative Mechanic – See water in various forms and use your creativity to solve the puzzles – totally stimulating! • Collectibles, Challenges, and Bonus Levels – Collect special items uniquely designed for each character and complete cool challenges to unlock bonus levels! “Tri-Duck” each level for ultimate bragging rights! SWAMPY’S STORY Swampy the Alligator lives in the sewers under the city. He’s a little different from the other alligators – he’s curious, friendly, and loves taking a nice long shower after a hard day at work. But there’s trouble with the pipes and Swampy needs your help getting water to his shower! ALLIE’S STORY Allie is the sewer's most creative alligator. Her quirky spirit and artistic talents made her a star. Now, the gators have crafted a one-of-a-kind steam-powered musical instrument, and can't wait to hear her play it! Help Allie get the steam she needs and enjoy her take on classic Disney tunes. CRANKY’S STORY Cranky, a real gator’s gator, has a big appetite and will eat anything, from tires to old fish bones. But he refuses to eat his greens! Use the dirty purple water to clear the algae on Cranky’s plate so he can gobble up his “food”. MYSTERY DUCK Catch this fancy teleporting Mystery Duck in this special chapter and hint hint - timing is everything! Some stories may require a small additional price but try the FREE levels today!

Doesn’t matter. Stay off the tracks! *To enjoy the full game experience, use a device that has an accelerometer and supports touch. Some games are not available on devices without these features. *This game is designed for Windows 8. It has not been optimised for Windows 10. © Metro Trains Melbourne, Dumb Ways to Die™

Nossa lista de comentaristas tem alguns dos maiores formadores de opinião do país, como Arnaldo Jabor, Carlos Alberto Sardenberg e Juca Kfouri. Acesse e selecione os que você mais gosta. Escute podcasts dos comentaristas a qualquer hora do dia e os siga no Twitter. Acompanhe os blogs da emissora, em uma plataforma intuitiva e prazerosa. Leia notícias do mundo todo no Portal CBN. O conceito de jornalismo praticado pela CBN é de isenção, com espaço para a pluralidade de opiniões e análise crítica do que está por trás dos fatos. São cerca de 150 jornalistas, entre repórteres, produtores, editores, âncoras e comentaristas. A CBN mantém parcerias com a BBC Brasil, que abastece a rede com material exclusivo para os ouvintes; com a seção brasileira da Radio France; e com a Rádio ONU. CBN - a rádio que toca notícia.

Description: Piece together the FUN in Microsoft Jigsaw! Discover hundreds of puzzles across three (3) winning game modes: Classic, Jigsaw Jam, & Daily Challenges. Pick a favorite puzzle, create your own, or unlock NEW puzzle collections as you play. Find relaxation and joy as you exercise your mind. Classic Jigsaw: Complete traditional jigsaw puzzles with endless themes and images to choose from. Select the number of pieces to make it easy, moderate or difficult. Zoom-in, auto-arrange, or use special in-game trays to get organized. If you enjoy real jigsaw puzzling, Classic Mode is the experience for you! Jigsaw Jam: Looking for an energy boost, complete puzzles as you race against the clock. Place each piece quickly to earn bonus multipliers and build a high score! Jigsaw Jam is easy to play but challenging to master. Daily Challenges: Discover new challenges every day! Complete fresh jigsaw puzzles and game modes to earn badges throughout the month. Custom Puzzles: Turn a favorite memory or photo into a jigsaw puzzle! Upload a picture to easily transform into playable pieces. Share your custom puzzles with friends and family. Sign In: Create a Microsoft Account to save your progress, track your game stats or play on multiple devices. Play Microsoft Jigsaw today!

Name: Microsoft Jackpot
Description: A vibrant casino slot experience with engaging themes and daily rewards Immersive Casino-Style Gameplay Microsoft Jackpot brings the excitement of video slots straight to your desktop, offering a lively, casino-inspired environment tailored for Windows users. The game stands out with its richly themed machines, eye-catching animations, and captivating sound effects that create a genuine slot machine atmosphere without the need to visit a real casino. Distinctive Themes and Engaging Bonus Rounds Players can explore a variety of slot machines, each with its own unique storyline and visual flair—ranging from deep-sea adventure in search of treasures to daring missions chasing elusive jewel thieves. These distinctive themes do more than provide eye candy; they spice up the experience with dynamic bonus mini-games and features that go beyond classic slot gameplay. Unlocking and participating in these bonuses often means a chance at bigger virtual winnings and adds an extra layer of challenge. Accessible and Free to Play Microsoft Jackpot’s free-to-play structure makes it accessible to a wide audience. Daily logins reward players with increasing coin bonuses, encouraging frequent play. Additional boosts, such as collectible items, can be earned and used to improve winning chances or unlock special game modes—keeping the experience fresh and rewarding for both newcomers and slot enthusiasts. Integration and Progression Features The game benefits from tight integration with Xbox services and Microsoft accounts. This allows players to synchronize progress across different Windows devices, participate in leaderboards, and collect achievements that add replay value. The cloud saving functionality means games can be paused on one device and resumed on another, offering convenience for users on the go. User-Friendly Experience The straightforward interface makes jumping into the action quick and effortless. Navigation across machines and game menus is intuitive, with clear and readable controls ideal for users of all skill levels. Vibrant graphics and lively audio cues contribute to the overall appeal while maintaining a smooth user experience on most Windows PCs.

Name: Network Speed Test
Description: How fast is your Internet connection? Network Speed Test measures your network delay, download speed and upload speed. Using servers all over the world, Network Speed Test measures your network connection’s latency and throughput. Based on your connection’s speed, Network Speed Test will tell you what activities you might be able to do, such as stream music or video calls. Slide to the right to see a history of your previous tests for easy comparisons. When you test your network using the Network Speed Test, certain characteristics of your device and the network connection will be sent to Microsoft to help improve our understanding of network quality and availability. If you consent, we may also collect information about your location at the time of the test. The data we collect is not associated with you, and will not be used to identify or contact you or for other purposes like targeted marketing. For additional information, see our privacy statement.
